rows.dataset: Projects Exiting LIHTC Program Affordability Period
rows.access: Public web; manual browser download only (Crosstab->CSV). Export is UTF-16 TAB-delimited. OBTAINED.
rows.notes: Authoritative state source; reflects re-syndications HUD cannot see. Column is 'Est. Program Exit' - still an estimate. Validated derived PIS+30 dates: 91% within +/-1yr, but misses re-syndications by up to 52 years. Raw at data/raw/ohfa/data.csv.

rows.access: FREE REGISTRATION REQUIRED — not created here
rows.notes: Cross-program inventory with dedup, S8 renewal status, and Section 202/811/USDA 515/HOME/HTF. NOTE: its LIHTC end dates use the same PIS+30 derivation computed here — it does NOT validate them. For actual LIHTC extended-use dates use OHFA.

rows.records: ~2,700 owned units; ~4,000 Housing Choice Vouchers; ~7,000 families
rows.access: Website lists property names + bedroom mix (paginated, no bulk file). Direct request for unit-level data.
rows.notes: PHA for Montgomery County. 400 Wayne Ave, Dayton OH 45410 | (937) 910-7500 | publichousing@gdpm.org. Property directory at /housing-programs/gdpm-owned-housing/ (LOAD MORE pagination). ALTERNATIVE without asking them: HUD 'Picture of Subsidized Households' publishes PHA- and project-level counts, occupancy, demographics and rents. Route outreach through Dave.

rows.access: Built from public REST layers; scripts/build_address_bridge.py
rows.notes: Accela.ADDRKEY -> UsedAddress.ADDRKEY -> TAXPINNO. 99.97% match. Validated: complaint rate rises monotonically with HCS grade (2.5% vacant lot -> 53% dilapidated). See dictionaries/address-parcel-bridge.md

rows.dataset: Building permits & trade licences (49 record types)
rows.access: Public web; no API. POST with __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTTARGET, paginated. VERIFIED live.
rows.notes: The city's live permitting system. Wrecking/demolition, building, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, RVO, zoning-only, waivers, trade licences. Scraping route established by Code for Dayton demolition_checker. See dictionaries/accela-permits-aca.md

rows.access: Public web; same postback mechanics as the Building module
rows.notes: Planning/Planning Case/NA/NA. Zoning and land-use case records.

rows.access: Public — direct CSV download, no auth. HARVESTED.
rows.notes: Parcel ID, address, agent type/name/phone/mailing address, unit count. The roster behind the taxroll RENTALREG flag. Dayton (R72) = 7,146 registrations / 16,846 units. Agent names are free text - normalize before aggregating portfolios.

rows.access: Public — ArcGIS REST, no auth. HARVESTED.
rows.notes: GDPM (PHA code OH005). Separate inventory from project-based Section 8 - only 2 of 13 developments overlap. Includes occupancy rates, resident counts, bedroom mix, 4,905 Housing Choice Vouchers.

rows.access: NOT PUBLISHED — only the registration form and ordinance are online
rows.notes: City registry of vacant properties exists under ordinance but no roster is published. The County publishes its rental registry as 67 CSVs - a direct precedent for asking the City to do the same. PRIORITY REQUEST.

rows.access: Public web — PDFs only; underlying HMIS not published
rows.notes: 2025 Homeless Data Snapshot, 2023-2025 CoC Performance Measures. Standardized HUD reporting - extractable. Underlying HMIS data has a known owner to ask.
